identity.title: Single vs Dual Monitor Arm for Small Desks

editorial.summary: Choose a single arm when one screen is enough; choose a dual arm when two displays need to leave the desktop on a small apartment desk.

seo.metaTitle: Single vs Dual Monitor Arm for Small Desks
seo.metaDescription: Compare a compact single monitor arm with a dual monitor arm for small home-office desks—footprint, screen count, and when each wins.

primary.summary: Legacy catalog pick when two screens need to leave a shallow desktop.
Product V1 generic single-arm class when one display is enough.

products.winnerReason: For most small desks that already run two monitors, a dual arm recovers more usable surface in one upgrade. Pick the single arm when you only need one screen raised.
